interpretation.what_is_falsified: Using caller-declared ContextItem.cost_units as if it were sufficient evidence of actual dereferenced/rendered byte or token cost.
interpretation.what_is_not_falsified: WP306 deterministic reference selection, channel constraints, digest carriage, or its boundedness in the abstract caller-declared cost-unit domain.
interpretation.why: The exact current ContextCompiler is deliberately reference-only and never reads payload bytes. The experiment proves that abstract compile-time cost boundedness can coexist with a much larger rendered payload unless a separate trusted render/token cost witness closes the boundary.

external_primary_support.source: Hugging Face Transformers chat templating documentation
external_primary_support.claim_used: Chat templates add model-specific formatting/control tokens; tokenization should be bound to the actual applied template/tokenizer, with tokenize=True presented as the safer path for avoiding special-token duplication.
The loaded model supplies the chat template, the template is applied before inference, and the resulting prompt is tokenized through the loaded model vocabulary before decode.

architecture_delta.old_interpretation: ContextCompiler max_cost_units bounds the caller-declared abstract cost dimension only.
architecture_delta.new_required_boundary: Before a ContextView is admitted to a concrete inference engine under a real context/token budget, bind selected payload digests to the exact dereference/render result and the exact renderer/chat-template plus production tokenizer/model/runtime identity; measure rendered bytes and tokenizer-specific input tokens; fail closed on digest/source/template/tokenizer mismatch or budget overflow.
architecture_delta.recommended_shape: Keep ContextCompiler model-agnostic. Add a separate deterministic ContextRenderCostWitness/adapter downstream, rather than importing semantic rendering/tokenizer logic into WP306 core.
architecture_delta.authority_impact: NONE: witness is measurement/admission evidence only and cannot mint truth/effect/completion authority.
architecture_delta.rollback_boundary: Research experiment/workflow are isolated under research/tool_intelligence plus one research-only workflow; product source remains unchanged.

production_boundary.required_next_gate: Trigger 4: implement or bind a production ContextRenderCostWitness to the actual selected inference renderer/template/tokenizer identity and reproduce reject/re-cost behavior on the real inference path, including template overhead and stale/mutated payload rejection.
